rules.when: Research or research cross-check scouts (R1-R6 and the cross-check), and any new factual research question
rules.why: Owner requires gpt-6.1-sol or gpt-6-luna for research

rules.when: Plan synthesis, plan critique, algorithm audits, privacy/consent/security reviews, and medical-content fact-checks
rules.why: Highest-stakes judgment; errors here are expensive to find later

rules.when: High-risk implementation: prediction engine, encryption, key exchange, sync, permissions, data layer, migrations
rules.why: Start cheap with more thinking; escalate to the strong model after two failed rounds

rules.when: Routine implementation, UI components, tests, docs, integration tasks, code review and UX/accessibility verification of low-risk work
